name: Linda Steigmeyer
original_name: リンダ・スティッグマイヤー
source:
AnAn American exchange student who came to the protagonists' academy through an exchange program. She was a cheerleader in high school and joined the academy's cheerleading club after transferring; she's a second-year student.

Kei, who ended up in the same class, takes on a sort of caretaker role and looks after her in various ways. She feels sympathetic towards Kei, who is always bullied by Rei at the academy.

While trying to comfort Kei, she gradually finds herself drawn to him. Being selected as an exchange student means she's reasonably smart. But she has an airheaded, natural-born character that hides it.

Her slangy English gives her a ditzy persona. Seeing Kei being teased by Rei at the academy triggers her maternal instincts, solidifying her feelings for him and putting her at odds with Rei.

She is over 5'7" with huge breasts and a toned body honed by cheerleading. She lived near Rei and Kei when they were kids in America and played with them.

In a way, she could be considered their childhood friend.
